*But if... But if I did indeed become family to this woman, and our time ended up shared under the same roof, it would doubtless be as close to bliss as my life could ever get.*
*My mind wandered back to three years ago.*
*To the time when I was at my lowest point.*
*Air Force chasing us away, Hashiba and I spent our days living like wild animals. And it was Toujou Heihachirou who saved us from that hell.*
*At the time, all I knew about him was his name, and the rumors of his enterprise from the newspapers. So I knew full well that he was far from a saint. I knew he was the type of man who could sacrifice a whole country for his ambitions.*
*Still, to the poor wretches of the lowest stratum of society he seemed like a God. Like a messiah.*
*We didn't think twice before following his orders; we became like an extension of his own body, acting solely to his will; even if the job in question had been far from virtuous. And thanks to us, he regained a part of his riches, and a part of his waned influence.*
*One day he called Hashiba and myself to his abode, and told us:*
"Why don't you become my sons?"
*I didn't know what simmered in his heart as he said those words. His real family -- his daughter -- had passed away just a while ago.*
*My mind cold as a knife, I let him know that he could not adopt children if he had a criminal record. He gave me a hearty laugh with a hint of forlornness about it, and told me he was just jesting.*
*What would have become of me if I had given him a nod that day? Would I have been living as his son now? Would I have had a real family for once...?*
"Now that I think about it, I never had the chance to introduce you to Grandpa officially."
*Momiji's voice pulled me back to reality. She stood right next to me, an affectionate smile on her face.*
*Was I to meet him as a son-in-law? Me? Who had once rejected such an offer?*
"Relax, Grandpa is not as bad as he looks."
"I know."
*We lined up behind Altey and Alice -- all four in front of the solemn doors.*

*click* The door was unlocked.
*Momiji squeezed on my hand. Her fingers shook slightly. She might've been acting tough, but in reality she was just as nervous as I was.*
*I squeezed her hand back. The imposing doors rupturing in the middle, coming ajar in front of us.*
*Alice was the first to take a step into the room.*
"Master? Good mo--"
*She stopped mid-sentence.*
*I could feel the mood of the place transform, take on a different face in an instant.*
*Altey, who entered the room right after Alice, let out a scream. A wordless shriek that pierced the silent mood of the house like a knife.*
*I jumped into the room ahead of Momiji.*
*Alice's gaze was fixed on the grand baldachin bed.*
*Where Toujou Heihachirou lay dead.*
"Huh?? Wh-What's going on?!"
"Mrs. Momiji, please stop!"
*As Momiji momentarily stopped in the doorway, I fueled all of my faculties to full power to assess the situation.*
*Atop the bed, atop the whitest of sheets, Mr. Toujou lay naked on his back.*
*The hilt of a knife stuck out from his chest, and a dark crimson stain of blood had pooled on the sheets behind his back. Ashen skin, congealed blood -- he was as dead as one could get.*

"Mrs. Momiji, are you all right? Y-You should rest--"

*As I took Momiji down to the dining hall, I found all other current inhabitants of the mansion already there.*
*We all sat in the same seats as yesterday. Arisawa Hideto on the right, and Alice with Altey on the left. Doctor Hinata and Aoi sat at the opposite end of the table from Mr. Toujou's seat, now vacant. I took a seat next to Arisawa Hideto.*

"What's going on here? I am quite certain I heard that breakfast was served at eight in this house."

"Toujou Heihachirou has passed away."

*To her right, Doctor Hinata let out a small sigh, both of his eyes shut. I could almost hear his muted exasperation from over here.*
*In front of me sat Altey in complete silence. We probably won't be seeing her bizarre antics today.*
*Alice, like me, was considering everyone at the table, one by one. Were we of one mind? Or, given her coolness and intellect, was she a few steps ahead of me already?*

"I think it would be better if we didn't contact the police."
"Wh-What?! Why?!"

"How about you, Professor?"
"Yes, I too think that we should avoid dealing with police."

Beyond those doors lay the body of a dead man, and yet they didn't seem nervous in the slightest, nor hesitant to invade the privacy of the deceased. *We only had one murder, didn't we? It seemed like these events had set off something inside Doctor Hinata. I sincerely hoped the shock of murder hadn't mad him lose his wits or something.*
